ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file with a non-".rsp" extension.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f\\ .*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rsp.*") OR (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\runonce\.exe" AND process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\odbcconf\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\/E\\ \\/F\\ \\"C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\system32\\\\odbcconf\\\.tmp\\.*")))
